dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Frontal lobe epilepsy, genetic (idiopathic, non-lesional) form, arising from the supplementary motor area/anterior cingulate, presenting with convulsive axial-truncal rotation and forced versive head/eye deviation, with apparently generalized bifrontal polyspike-and-wave discharges on scalp EEG due to rapid secondary bilateral synchrony from a midline frontal focus.
